avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces donepezil levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult prescriber before starting St. John's Wort

avoid_supplements.name: Anticholinergic Supplements (Scopolia, Hyoscyamus)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Direct antagonism of donepezil's cholinergic mechanism of action

caution_supplements.name: NSAIDs (as supplements)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May increase GI irritation; donepezil can cause nausea and GI upset
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for GI symptoms; use lowest effective dose

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo Biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive cholinergic effects may increase adverse events
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for dizziness, syncope, and GI symptoms

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay donepezil absorption; no effect on bioavailability
caution_foods.action: Take donepezil consistently with or without food for optimal effect

caution_foods.name: Foods high in tyramine
caution_foods.mechanism: Potential for cholinergic excess symptoms in sensitive patients
caution_foods.action: No strict restriction needed; monitor for nausea or bradycardia

monitoring_notes: Monitor heart rate and rhythm as donepezil can cause bradycardia and syncope. Assess for GI distress, particularly nausea and diarrhea, which are common dose-limiting adverse effects.
